# Dheer Joshi — Portfolio

> Portfolio of Dheer Joshi, a young innovator from Vadodara, India building AI and IoT projects including WildSentry, EV Armour, and Ric.

Dheer Joshi is a student innovator focused on solving real-world problems through IoT, artificial intelligence, robotics, and engineering. This site collects his projects, achievements, skills, mentors, academic documents, and reviews.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Dheer Joshi with hero intro, about, and highlights across all sections.
- [Projects](/projects): Full list of engineering and AI/IoT projects including WildSentry, EV Armour, and Ric.
- [Achievements](/achievements): Awards, recognitions, and competition results.
- [Mentors](/mentors): People who have guided Dheer's technical and academic journey.
- [Skills](/skills): Technical and soft skills across hardware, software, and AI.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Photos from events, builds, and demonstrations.
- [Documents](/documents): Academic marksheets and certificates.
- [Reviews](/reviews): Public reviews and testimonials.
- [Summary](/summary): One-page recap combining projects, mentors, achievements, and skills.
- [Chat](/chat): Rule-based chatbot that answers questions about Dheer using site content.

## Optional

- [Contact](/#contact): Email and social links to reach Dheer.
